_comment: Per-VST default control maps. Keys are exact plugin names as FL reports them. Each entry may have 'knob' and/or 'slider' arrays of up to 8 parameter names (as they appear in vst_param_scans/<plugin>.json) - unspecified or unmatched slots fall through to the normal auto-mapper. Edit freely; this file is re-read on every patch commit, no script reload needed.
